headline: This is a $73 street sweeping parking ticket from City Parking Services.
summary: You got a ticket for parking during street sweeping hours on Maple Grove Ave. You can pay $73 or ask the city to review it. The ticket has two real mistakes: it says your car is a HONDA, but the officer wrote that it was a Toyota Camry. And the officer's name and ID number are missing. These mistakes can help you get the ticket cancelled.

deadline.what_is_due: Pay $73 or ask for an initial review before the late fee is added.

if_ignored: A $73 late fee will be added, so you would owe $146. The city may also put a hold on your car registration at the DMV, which means you can't renew it until you pay. You would also lose the chance to fight the ticket.

action_steps.title: Check your car and the street
action_steps.detail: Make sure plate 8ABC123 is yours and note your car's real make. If you can, go back to the 1200 block of Maple Grove Ave and take photos of the street sweeping signs and the curb.

action_steps.title: Send your appeal letter
action_steps.detail: Use the ready-made letter below. Fill in the yellow parts. Submit it online, by mail, or call. Do this before {{DATE:+16}}.

action_steps.title: Call if you have questions
action_steps.detail: City Parking Services answers Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM. Have citation number FG-4471902 ready.

action_steps.title: Keep proof
action_steps.detail: Save a copy of your letter, your photos, and any confirmation number. If the review says no, you can ask for an administrative hearing (a meeting with a hearing officer).

red_flags.text: The vehicle make says HONDA, but the officer's note says the car was a Toyota Camry. The ticket doesn't agree with itself.
The issuing officer name / ID box is empty. A valid ticket should say who wrote it.
The ticket does not say which sign or which side of the street had the sweeping schedule. Check that the sign was clear and visible.

reasons: It has a citation number, a mailing address, and normal ways to pay or contest.
It does not ask for gift cards, wire transfers or crypto.

ticket.violation: FGMC 10.36.120 — Street sweeping (no parking 8–10 AM on posted sweeping day)
missing_or_wrong_fields: Vehicle make says HONDA, but remarks say Toyota Camry
possible_grounds: Street sweeping signs were missing, blocked or hard to read
The street was not actually swept that day
Your car was sold or not there at that time
ticket.contest_strength_reason: The ticket has clear mistakes on its face: the car make doesn't match the officer's own description, and there is no officer ID. Agencies often cancel tickets with errors like these.
